title: When the Harvest Wakes
author: Marguerite Halloran
blurb: Ansel Vane, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
